name: Fun Dive (Single Tank)
notes: Source: maafushidive.com (diving rates / diving price list pages, operator's own site). A single boat dive for already-certified divers, $50/dive, with multi-dive packages also listed (4 tanks $192, 6 tanks $270, 8 tanks $352, 10 tanks $430, 11th dive onward $40). Price includes boat trip, dive guide and full equipment (tank, weight, belt, fins, mask, BCD, regulator, snorkel, computer); a 3% surcharge applies for card payment. Only the single-dive base rate was recorded as price_from to avoid padding near-duplicate package tiers from the same page. Distinct from the operator's existing 'Discover Scuba Diving (DSD)' and 'PADI Open Water Diver Course' entries already in the dataset.

name: Advanced Open Water Diver Course
notes: Source: maafushidive.com/products/adventure-course and related course-listing pages (operator's own site). PADI Advanced Open Water Diver course for already-Open-Water-certified divers, $400, comprising 5 adventure dives (2 mandatory, 3 selectable). duration_minutes left null since the course spans multiple dives/days rather than one timed session; difficulty left null since the source describes it only in terms of skill-building, not a labeled beginner/intermediate/advanced tier in its own wording.

name: Night Diver Specialty Course
notes: Source: maafushidive.com (Night Dive / Night Diver Specialty course pages, operator's own site). PADI Night Diver specialty certification: 3 adventure dives over 2-3 nights, $330. Open to Open Water divers or higher, including Junior divers 12+ (recorded as min_age). The site separately confirms that Maafushi's plain 'Night Dive' (non-certification) product is restricted to advanced divers or holders of the night specialty, but no distinct price was found for that non-course night dive, so it was not added as a separate entry to avoid an unpriced near-duplicate of this course. duration_minutes left null since the course spans multiple nights rather than a single timed session.

name: Discover Scuba Diving
notes: Source: Baros Maldives' own 'Dive Course Prices, May 2023' PDF (baros.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Baros-Maldives-Dive-Courses-Price-List-May-2023_revised.pdf), listed under its 'Beginners Dive Programmes' section. Discover Scuba Diving (1 dive), $195/person, run by Divers Baros Maldives (the same real, long-established PADI Five Star Gold Palm dive centre already used as operator_name for the existing 'Guided Reef Dive' entry). Prices are in USD subject to 10% service charge and 16% GST per the source; base course price used as price_from. Duration and max participants not stated in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Fluo Night Diving
notes: Source: baros.com/divers-baros-maldives/diving/fluo-night-diving (operator's own page). A fluorescence night dive run by Divers Baros Maldives: divers are equipped with blue UV torches and a yellow mask filter to see reef life that fluoresces under blue light, preceded by a briefing/presentation on fluorescent marine life. Price and duration not found in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Fun Dive
notes: Source: soleni.com/dive-center/rates (Soleni Dive Center's own rates page, referenced via search) plus corroborating pricing summary. Soleni Dive Center is Soneva Fushi's real onsite PADI-affiliated dive operation (opened October 1995, on Kunfunadhoo island, Baa Atoll). A single guided dive for certified divers is listed at $89, with equipment rental ($33) and boat trip ($42) shown as separate line items on the same rate card rather than bundled into one all-inclusive figure -- $89 (the base per-dive rate) was used as price_from, but the true fully-equipped boat-dive cost may be higher; flagged as a caveat in SOURCES.md. New operator, not one of the 10 existing providers.

name: PADI Open Water Diver Course
notes: Source: soleni.com/dive-center/rates (Soleni Dive Center's own rates page). Full PADI Open Water Diver certification course at Soneva Fushi's onsite dive centre, $1,090/person -- notably higher than the equivalent Maafushi-based course already in the dataset ($475), consistent with Soneva Fushi being a high-end resort. duration_minutes left null since the course spans multiple days; difficulty recorded as beginner as the entry-level PADI certification, matching the convention used for the equivalent existing Maafushi entry.

name: PADI Bubble Maker
notes: Source: Six Senses Laamu / Deep Blue Divers pricing coverage (search snippets citing the resort's dive centre rate sheet). PADI Bubble Maker is a shallow-water introductory scuba program for children, priced at USD 150++ for ages 8 to 9 (min_age recorded as 8). Deep Blue Divers is Six Senses Laamu's own PADI 5-star dive centre on Olhuveli island, Laamu Atoll (a new operator, not one of the 10 existing providers). Duration and max participants not found in snippets reviewed; left null. A separate note in the same coverage mentions a USD 100 discount off a PADI course for guests who sign up with the centre, but that discount is not a standalone bookable product so was not recorded as its own entry.

name: Discover Scuba Diving
notes: Source: velassaru.com/experiences/dive-discover/ and velassaru.com/experiences/sea/ (resort's own pages), corroborated by the Immersion Dive Centre Facebook page. Discover Scuba Diving (1-3 dives) for first-time/non-certified divers, training conducted in the resort's own ~9m-deep lagoon. Immersion is Velassaru Maldives' onsite PADI dive centre (a new operator, distinct from the resort's own accommodation operator, which is left null in accommodations.json, mirroring the same distinction already made for Baros/Divers Baros Maldives). A figure of '$210' surfaced in one search summary but could not be confidently tied to this specific course rather than another Immersion product, so price_from was left null rather than guessed.

name: PADI Open Water Diver Course
notes: Source: seastarsdiving.com/padi-open-water-diver (operator's own page). Sea Star Diving is a real PADI dive centre on Thulusdhoo island (established 2018), offering guided boat dives to 25+ North Male Atoll sites. Its Open Water Diver course spans up to 4 days and requires a minimum age of 15 (recorded as min_age; PADI's standard Open Water minimum is normally 10, so this operator's own stated 15+ policy was used rather than the generic PADI figure). Price not found in snippets reviewed; left null. New operator, not one of the 10 existing providers.

name: Discover Scuba Diving
notes: Source: search-result pricing summary for feenaadive.com / Feenaa Diving Thulusdhoo (a small, real, independently-run PADI/SSI-affiliated dive centre on Thulusdhoo island, distinct from Sea Star Diving on the same island). Discover Scuba Diving program for beginners priced at $100. Duration and max participants not found in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Fun Dive (Single Tank)
notes: Source: same search-result pricing summary as the Feenaa Diving Discover Scuba Diving entry above. A single dive for an already-certified diver costs an estimated $65 (two dives approx. $105). Marked as an estimate in the source itself, so treat this price with slightly lower confidence than the Discover Scuba Diving figure from the same operator, which was stated more plainly.

name: PADI Open Water Diver Course
notes: Source: euro-divers.com/kurumba-maldives-dive-centre, padi.com dive-center listing for 'Euro-Divers Niva Kurumba', and Tripadvisor listing/reviews for 'Euro-Divers Kurumba'. Euro-Divers is a real, long-running (since 1972) PADI 5-star dive operator running the onsite dive centre at Kurumba Maldives (Vihamanaafushi island, Kaafu Atoll) -- distinct from 'Universal Resorts', the resort's own accommodation operator already in providers.json, mirroring the Baros/Divers Baros Maldives and Velassaru/Immersion distinctions elsewhere in this file. Offers the standard PADI Open Water Diver course among other courses and dive trips. One search summary surfaced a EUR 216 figure but could not confidently tie it to this specific course rather than another product or date, so price_from was left null rather than guessed or converted.

name: Discover Scuba Diving
notes: Source: gili-lankanfushi.com/experience/diving/ and the padi.com dive-center listing for 'Ocean Paradise' (North Male Atoll). Ocean Paradise Dive Centre is Gili Lankanfushi's real onsite PADI dive centre, offering PADI courses for adults and children plus guided leisure dives; most beginner training takes place on the resort's own house reef. New operator, not one of the 10 existing providers. Price and duration not found in snippets reviewed; left null.
